name: SupportResistTrade
summary: This EA identifies support and resistance levels and trades breakouts from those levels. It enters buy positions when price breaks above resistance and sell positions when price breaks below support. The system includes configurable parameters for level detection sensitivity, stop loss, and take profit settings.
summary_zh: 该EA通过识别支撑位和阻力位，在这些价位被突破时进行交易。当价格突破阻力位时开多仓，当价格跌破支撑位时开空仓。系统包含可配置的水平检测灵敏度、止损和止盈参数。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于支撑位和阻力位的突破交易。入场条件为：当价格向上突破识别到的阻力位时开多单，当价格向下突破识别到的支撑位时开空单。支撑和阻力位的识别依赖于历史价格极值的检测算法，通过参数控制检测的灵敏度和回溯周期。出场条件包括固定的止损和止盈设置，止损设在支撑/阻力位的另一侧以控制风险。仓位管理方面，EA支持固定手数交易，部分版本可能包含基于账户余额的动态仓位计算。资金管理方面，该EA依赖止损来控制单笔交易的风险敞口，但缺少整体账户风险控制机制如最大回撤限制或连续亏损后的仓位缩减规则。策略在震荡市中可能频繁出现假突破导致连续止损，而在趋势明确的市场中表现较好。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on trading breakouts from identified support and resistance levels. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when price breaks above a detected resistance level, and a sell position is opened when price breaks below a detected support level. The support and resistance identification relies on a historical price extremum detection algorithm, with configurable parameters controlling detection sensitivity and lookback period. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit settings, where stop loss is placed on the opposite side of the support/resistance level to manage risk. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size approach, though some variants may include dynamic lot calculation based on account balance. Money management relies on stop loss to control per-trade risk exposure, but lacks overall account risk controls such as maximum drawdown limits or position reduction rules after consecutive losses. The strategy may suffer from frequent false breakouts in ranging markets leading to consecutive stop losses, while performing better in strongly trending markets.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, limits max loss per trade

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, locks profit target per trade

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: Magic number for closing, 0 for all positions

pros: 支撑阻力突破是经典且逻辑清晰的趋势交易策略，在趋势行情中表现优秀
策略概念易于理解，参数较少，适合初学者使用和调整
设有止损止盈机制，单笔交易风险可控
pros_en: Support/resistance breakout is a classic and logically clear trend trading strategy that performs well in trending markets
Strategy concept is easy to understand with relatively few parameters, suitable for beginners to use and adjust
Stop loss and take profit mechanisms are in place, keeping per-trade risk controllable
cons: 在震荡行情中容易遭遇假突破，导致频繁止损和连续亏损
缺乏趋势过滤机制，未结合更高时间周期趋势判断来过滤交易信号
缺少资金管理模块如最大回撤限制、连续亏损保护或动态仓位调整
支撑阻力位的识别方法较为简单，未考虑成交量或多次测试确认等增强条件
cons_en: Prone to false breakouts in ranging markets, leading to frequent stop losses and consecutive losses
Lacks a trend filter mechanism, does not combine higher timeframe trend judgment to filter trade signals
Missing money management module such as maximum drawdown limits, consecutive loss protection, or dynamic position sizing
Support/resistance identification method is relatively simple, without considering volume confirmation or multiple test validation
improvements: 增加多时间周期趋势过滤，仅在更高时间周期趋势方向一致时才入场，减少假突破损失
加入ATR动态止损止盈替代固定点数，使风险管理适应市场波动率变化
添加资金管理模块，包括最大回撤限制和连续亏损后的仓位缩减规则
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe trend filtering, only entering trades when aligned with higher timeframe trend direction to reduce false breakout losses
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit instead of fixed pip values, adapting risk management to market volatility changes
Add a money management module including maximum drawdown limits and position reduction rules after consecutive losses

risk_points: 在震荡市中假突破导致连续止损的风险较高
缺少账户级别的风险控制机制如最大回撤限制
固定止损可能在高波动时段不足以覆盖市场噪音
risk_points_en: High risk of consecutive stop losses from false breakouts in ranging markets
Missing account-level risk controls such as maximum drawdown limits
Fixed stop loss may be insufficient to cover market noise during high volatility periods
